decision_details.domain_and_scenario: Actual T,nH,nHe,time/redshift,SED/IC ranges and source tail/secondary decisions. An existing constructor point is not a box.
decision_details.distribution_and_frame: Explicit distribution, gas frame, shared-temperature assumptions and supported departures.
decision_details.constants_and_geometry_adoption: Versioned source registry, chosen energy units and H=0/expanding status. Existing constants are observations until adopted.
decision_details.HH_enable_provider_cutoff_policy: Explicit off or opt-in; version-pinned LCS/KS selected separately; reject outside domain; no silent floor smoothing, extrapolation or blended providers.
decision_details.single_process_threshold_thermal_binding: Name the unique HH event owner and thermal/binding/threshold owners; preserve no extra 1/2 and chi binding energy.
decision_details.actual_HH_rhs_stepper_residual_event_sea: Exact selected commit/path/blob and signatures, source selector, positive-block update, thermal solve, residual and full/half event accumulation. No HH seam exists merely because RCT composition exists.
decision_details.observable_numeric_and_model_uncertainty: Chosen observables, dimensional scales, numerical tolerances and physical uncertainty interpretation. Unresolved empirical error may be explicitly scenario-only, never promoted to an enclosure.

conditional_findings: If owner adopts the unchanged FT03 call window and certifies every relevant state box inside it, 30000 K > 3000 K excludes the raw HH cutoff in that selected scope. A point guard alone is not trajectory/root enclosure.
Preserve typed ft03_rhs baseline. Ft03Model.gas has zero legacy alpha/beta, so routing to hhe_rhs(&ft03.gas) would omit FT03 RR/CI/DR.
Reuse the RCT design distinction baseline/extra event, not its chemistry, electron delta, radiative escape closure or provider admission.
HH thermal contribution is -chi*R with separate HH event; neither existing electron-CI slots nor RCT photon emission are valid substitutes.
Return HH-off/no-negligibility scope explicitly when baseline excludes it; this does not complete optional HH-F1/F2 or F09.
